top_5_cycle3_recommendations.name: Dual-Momentum Relative Strength & Sector Leadership
top_5_cycle3_recommendations.economic_mechanism: Equities exhibiting both absolute trend momentum and relative strength versus sector benchmarks experience sustained institutional capital inflows driven by momentum mandate fund allocations.
top_5_cycle3_recommendations.behavioral_basis: Herding behavior and performance chasing by institutional asset managers.
top_5_cycle3_recommendations.risk_factors: Sharp market sector rotation, choppy sideways consolidation.

top_5_cycle3_recommendations.name: Multi-Factor PEAD with Market Regime & Volume Confirmation
top_5_cycle3_recommendations.economic_mechanism: Institutional investors accumulate large-cap positions over 20-40 sessions following positive disclosures due to execution liquidity constraints. Adding market trend (SMA-200) and volume confirmation filters out false breakout whipsaws.
top_5_cycle3_recommendations.behavioral_basis: Delayed information diffusion and institutional execution pacing in large-cap equities.
top_5_cycle3_recommendations.implementation_originality: Custom Combination (PEAD + Market Regime + Volume Expansion Filter)

explicit_falsification_criteria.friction_sensitivity: Alpha disappears after standard fees + 5 bps slippage

data_requirements.quarterly_earnings: Required / Proxy via Event Disclosure Date

top_5_cycle3_recommendations.risk_factors: Severe market regime shifts, sudden macro liquidity withdrawal, post-earnings profit booking.

top_5_cycle3_recommendations.name: Quality-Volatility Anomaly (High ROE Low Beta)
top_5_cycle3_recommendations.economic_mechanism: High-quality, low-volatility firms generate superior risk-adjusted returns due to leverage constraints among benchmark-constrained institutional managers who overpay for high-beta lottery stocks.
top_5_cycle3_recommendations.behavioral_basis: Preference for lottery-like payoffs and institutional benchmark tracking constraints.
top_5_cycle3_recommendations.risk_factors: Value trap exposure, sharp speculative bull rallies.

top_5_cycle3_recommendations.name: Volatility Compression Keltner-Bollinger Squeeze
top_5_cycle3_recommendations.economic_mechanism: Periods of extreme volatility contraction are systematically followed by volatility expansion as market participants re-price asset risk upon new catalyst arrival.
top_5_cycle3_recommendations.behavioral_basis: Investor apathy during low-volatility consolidation followed by FOMO chasing during expansion.

top_5_cycle3_recommendations.name: Cross-Sectional Short-Term Reversal & Oversold Bounce
top_5_cycle3_recommendations.economic_mechanism: Short-term overreaction to non-fundamental news causes temporary price dislocations, which revert to mean as liquidity providers earn market-making spreads.
top_5_cycle3_recommendations.behavioral_basis: Investor panic and liquidity provider inventory constraints.

explicit_falsification_criteria.friction_sensitivity: Alpha destroyed by bid-ask spread and transaction costs

top_5_cycle3_recommendations.risk_factors: Falling knife exposure in fundamental bankruptcies.

full_candidate_backlog.behavioral_basis: Strong-hand accumulation absorbing weak-hand supply.
full_candidate_backlog.risk_factors: Broader market breakdown invalidating chart pattern.

full_candidate_backlog.name: Institutional Volume Breakout & Delivery Accumulation

full_candidate_backlog.behavioral_basis: Informed institutional order flow absorbing retail supply.
full_candidate_backlog.implementation_originality: Custom Combination (Volume Surge + Delivery Ratio + Price Breakout)
full_candidate_backlog.risk_factors: Fakeout volume spikes, distribution near resistance.
